title: Plugin Conflict Diagnosis
description: Systematically isolate plugin conflicts causing errors, broken features, or layout issues without guesswork.

steps.title: Document Symptoms and Recent Changes
steps.instructions: Record exact error messages, affected URLs, and any plugin/theme updates in the last 48 hours. Note if the issue is front-end only, admin only, or both.

steps.title: Reproduce on Staging
steps.instructions: Clone production to staging before testing. Never bulk-deactivate plugins on live client sites during business hours without a rollback plan.

steps.title: Enable Troubleshooting Mode
steps.instructions: Use the Health Check plugin troubleshooting mode to disable plugins for your session only, without affecting other visitors.

steps.title: Binary Search Plugin Groups
steps.instructions: Deactivate half the plugins at a time. When the issue clears, the conflict is in the disabled half. Narrow down until one plugin reproduces the problem.

steps.title: Check Browser Console for JS Conflicts
steps.instructions: Open DevTools → Console on affected pages. Script errors from two plugins loading incompatible libraries often point to the conflicting pair.

steps.title: Resolve or Replace Conflicting Plugin
steps.instructions: Update both plugins, change load order if supported, or replace one with an alternative. Contact plugin vendors with reproducible steps if needed.

steps.title: Document Resolution for Client
steps.instructions: Record which plugin caused the conflict, the fix applied, and any plugins that must not run together on this site.
